PluginData.Author: Polar
PluginData.Tooltip: Mass, TWR per direction, lift range and hover time at real, heavy and full load. Cockpit key and live while building
PluginData.Description:
Will this ship lift when it is full? See it before you fly, and before you place the next block.
- Weight now, heavy (full of ore) and max (densest cargo), in kg. - Thrust to weight ratio per direction at each load, for the air where you are, and whether each direction is space capable. - Lift range on a 0g to 1.5g scale per load. - Hover time with a heavy load at 1 g, hydrogen and batteries.
Cockpit: press ] to cycle full, collapsed, off. Building: hold a block aimed at a grid; its mass, thrust and symmetry copies are counted before you place it.
Settings: panel key, show while building, inventory size, thrust multiplier, panel size and position.
Client-side only, no Harmony patches. Rotor, piston and hinge subgrids count; connector-docked ships do not.
Docs and bug reports: https://github.com/Po11arr/PolarsThrustPreview
